answer_1.quote: We propose FIN-FORCE ... a novel benchmark to support LLM forward counterfactual generation in finance. ... The following models are tasked with generating a single risk and a single opportunity counterfactual from each headline in FIN-FORCE.
answer_1.outputs: risk counterfactual and opportunity counterfactual sentences per headline

answer_2.quote: We build on perplexity for fluency evaluation by focusing on Δ Perplexity ... We also introduce two new metrics—forward-compatibility and directionality ... The scores ... reflect the proportion (in percentages) of counterfactuals meeting the forward-compatibility and directionality criteria respectively.

answer_3.quote: Each generated counterfactual is presented to the LLM one at a time for evaluation, and separate runs are performed for assessing forward-compatibility and directionality. ... We use GPT-4o as the LLM judge.
methods: LLM-as-a-judge prompting for forward-compatibility and directionality

answer_4.quote: A total of five human contributors ... participated in the benchmark annotation ... We conducted a human-LLM agreement study ... to evaluate whether the LLM judge aligns with the preferences of proficient human annotators when using the criteria of forward-compatibility and directionality.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluated counterfactuals against forward-compatibility and directionality guidelines, marking each as TRUE or FALSE.
